stemMd: A town installed more water meters. Recorded water consumption increased even though reservoir withdrawals remained unchanged. Which fact best explains this?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The meters were bought in bulk.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The new meters recorded water use that had previously gone unmeasured.

explanationMd: The reservoir figure measures physical supply, while the recorded total depends on measurement coverage. Extending coverage can increase reported use without changing the amount withdrawn from the reservoir.

distractorRationale.e: Rainwater use does not by itself explain unchanged withdrawals with increased records.
distractorRationale.b: Purchase method does not determine recording coverage.
distractorRationale.d: Bill appearance does not explain the measurement difference.
distractorRationale.a: Location does not establish recorded consumption.
